card.title: The Gatekeeper
card.instruction: Use expertise and standards to decide who is qualified to judge, participate, or proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before joining our cheese panel, identify this rind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just came to eat cheese.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then identify it for the tasting queue. Judging requires the county certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have that certificate. I teach the county course.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Before you examine our cheese, let me examine your syllabus.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 tests rind expertise before participation; A3 separates tasting from certified judging, and A5 subjects the qualified teacher to another expertise check.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's wish to eat produces A3's queue distinction; B4's teaching credential shifts A5's test to the syllabus.

relationship.evidence: B2 states a simple participation aim and B4 supplies directly relevant qualification rather than an arbitrary obstacle.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's superior credential to move gatekeeping from possession of a certificate to the course behind it.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a cheese panel, A3 the judging standard, and B4 the teacher's qualification.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's examine-your-syllabus reversal is earned by B4's course expertise.
